newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Italy prepares decree for Stet sale-Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy prepares decree for Stet sale-Ciampi.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said he would present a decree to the government in the next few days paving the way for privatisation of state telecom group Stet by mid-October.
"The privatisation of Stet is going ahead according to the timetable," Ciampi told a news conference after a meeting of EU Finance Ministers.
"In the next few days I will present to the cabinet the decree for the privatisation," said Ciampi.
"The various steps allow us to expect the date of the privatisation to fall in the middle of October," said Ciampi.
The senate last month approved a bill to create a regulatory authority for the telecommunications industry which now has to go to the lower house for a final reading.
The privatisation caqnnot proceed until the regulatory authority has been established.
